Not carried over:
  keyboard.bindings[5] key='PageUp' mods='Shift' mode='~Alt' action='ScrollPageUp'
    mode '~Alt': Ghostty bindings cannot be limited to a terminal mode
  keyboard.bindings[9] key='Space' mods='Shift|Control' action='ToggleViMode'
    action 'ToggleViMode' has no Ghostty equivalent
  keyboard.bindings[10] key='K' mods='Control|Shift' command={'program': 'notify-send', 'args': ['hi']}
    bindings that run a program have no Ghostty equivalent
  mouse.bindings[0] mouse='Middle' action='PasteSelection'
    mouse bindings have no Ghostty equivalent
  bell.command = {'program': 'paplay', 'args': ['/usr/share/sounds/bell.oga']}
    Ghostty cannot run a program on the bell
  colors.dim.black = "#45475a"
    Ghostty has no dim palette; it dims faint text itself
  colors.primary.dim_foreground = "#7f849c"
    Ghostty has no dim foreground
  cursor.unfocused_hollow = False
    Ghostty always draws an unfocused cursor hollow
  cursor.vi_mode_style.blinking = "Off"
    Ghostty has no vi mode
  cursor.vi_mode_style.shape = "Block"
    Ghostty has no vi mode
  font.glyph_offset.y = 1
    no exact Ghostty equivalent (adjust-font-baseline moves the baseline only)
  general.live_config_reload = False
    Ghostty reloads with ctrl+shift+comma
  window.class.general = "work"
    Ghostty's class is its Wayland app id, which window rules match: not copied
  window.class.instance = "work"
    Ghostty's class is its Wayland app id, which window rules match: not copied
  window.dynamic_title = False
    no Ghostty equivalent (set title to fix the title)

Alacritty is still installed and its files were not changed.
